question: What is the principal structure of the 33-module eigengene space across all 474 samples? Analysis 009 showed a consistent downward shift in BP. Does PC1 of all-sample ME PCA capture the BP disease effect?
rationale: Analyses 001-004 ran PCA on 226 BP-only samples; PC2 captured the lithium-composition signal. This analysis runs PCA on all 460 samples with complete ILR data, asking if the PC structure differs when controls are included.
pre_specified_tests: PCA of 33-module ME matrix (460 x 33), scaled
Pearson r of PC1-PC5 with group (ctrl=0, nolith=1, lith=1 for disease; ctrl=0, nolith=0, lith=1 for lithium), ILR b1-b4
Permutation test: K=1000 label shuffles for PC1-group association
